content:
emily: Heads-up — OrbitEdge just confirmed they'd like us in the Auckland region. Need quick sync on marketplace entitlement + quota checks before we sign the LOI.
ken: awesome. do we have a target launch week?
emily: partner asked for calendar window in next 6–8 weeks. preferred early July.
sara: ops note — nz-south1 has limited GPU SKUs in marketplace. current quota request flow is slow, need partner-approved AMI and billing account attached.
alex: ping OrbitEdge to confirm which SKU they need (A100v4, H100?). i'll ask and loop in their infra lead.
emily: @alex please also ask if they can accept our quantized variants (fp16/4-bit) — that'll reduce capacity pressure.
chris: from eng side: runtime supports 4-bit quantized GA now, but marketplace images must include our 1.2.0 runtime + signed checksum. we can provide image build artifact.
ken: legal/entitlements: @lina do we need a special marketplace addendum for OrbitEdge since they're reselling dedicated nodes?
lina: quick answer: yes. reseller entitlements + export control clause. i'll draft a short addendum template, will need partner signature + OrbitEdge company registration to attach.
emily: OK — checklist I'm thinking: 1) partner SKU + AMI spec (alex) 2) marketplace entitlement addendum (lina) 3) quota request submitted to cloud marketplace (sara) 4) image/artifact + checksum (chris) 5) go/no-go by legal/ops (emily)
sara: for quota API we need these fields: {"project_id":"<partner-project>", "sku":"<sku-id>", "requested_units":"<int>"}. ETA to submit once alex confirms SKU: ~24h.
alex: OrbitEdge responded — asking for H100-80GB and A100-80GB both. says expected initial committed capacity: 4 nodes H100, 6 nodes A100.
chris: that maps to requested_units: H100=4, A100=6. note: H100 images must include kernel patch v2.3.1 due to PCIe firmware. i'll prepare image build with kernel patch and runtime.
emily: good. @sara can you open the quota ticket and tag cloud-partner-support? include partner legal name: OrbitEdge Ltd (NZ), company reg 987654321.
sara: opening ticket now... ticket #CLD-7642 created. link: https://internal.support/CLD-7642. added labels: marketplace, nz-south, orbitedge.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Image build job scheduled: build/ri-image-1718745600 started by chris. logs: https://ci.internal/builds/ri-image-1718745600
chris: build fell over first run — kernel module compile failed on GCC 11. retrying with toolchain pin.
alex: OrbitEdge legal asked for SLA language around latency for dedicated nodes — can we commit?
emily: we should offer an ops SLA for Dedicated customers but avoid hard P99 latency in marketplace contract. propose SLA: 99.9% instance availability + support SLAs. @lina thoughts?
lina: agree. we can add availability SLA + ops response SLA. avoid strict latency numbers in reseller marketplace contract.
ken: what about billing flow? OrbitEdge wants meter + settle monthly with us via marketplace credits. finance ok with partner reconciliation?
sara: finance ops require partner invoices + usage report export. marketplace automates tokenized settlements — we'll need to enable 'partner-settle' flag on the listing.
emily: next steps owners: alex (confirm SKUs + partner infra contact), chris (image + checksum), sara (quota ticket + marketplace flags), lina (addendum draft), ken (partner commercial terms), emily (overall sign-off). target internal check-in in 48h.
alex: i'll get partner infra lead (matt@orbitedge) on a call tomorrow 9am NZT.
chris: image build succeeded on retry, artifact: s3://ri-images/nz/ri-image-1718745600.tar.gz sha256: b2f5...
sara: quota request submitted to marketplace portal. reference #MP-Q-9921. waiting vendor approval.
lina: addendum draft pushed to GDrive: https://drive.internal/redwood/partners/orbitedge/addendum-draft-v1.docx — comments invited.
emily: perfect. if we hit vendor approval this week, we can aim for soft-launch in first week of July. thanks everyone :sparkles:
ken: thanks all. I'll prep a one-pager for biz-dev to share with OrbitEdge buyer.
emily: closing note: keep this thread for status updates only. escalate incidents to #release-war-room if anything blocks the launch.
emily: marking done for now, will reopen thread if blockers appear.
